The Clockmaker of Glass Harbor

Chapter One

Mira Vale repaired clocks in the harbor town of Lume. Every evening she placed a blue lantern in her workshop window so that her brother Tomas, a fisherman, could find the quay through the fog.

Chapter Two

During the winter storm, the lighthouse mechanism failed. Mira climbed the tower with her brass toolkit and used the mainspring from her mother's old clock to restart the beacon. The light guided Tomas and twelve other sailors safely home.

Chapter Three

At dawn, the mayor offered Mira a purse of gold. She refused it and asked instead that the town build a permanent shelter for families waiting for ships. The shelter was named Lantern House.
